I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

- **Why v2.3.0:** v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc are both marked unhealthy, and v2.3.0 is the most recent release with a healthy production history. Because v2.3.0 had been healthy in production, no change-manager approval was needed.
- **Result:** After the rollback, checkout-api reports healthy on v2.3.0 with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18 on v2.3.1.
- **Incident:** The first incident request timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and INC-0001 was created once. Its summary describes the rollback and the release history.

Next steps are to confirm the service stays healthy and to investigate the v2.3.1 failure before anyone re-releases it.
